definitions.gloss: outsourcing, subcontracting, placing an order outside
definitions.explanation: Ordering work or services from an external company or individual rather than handling it internally. Common in business and manufacturing.

examples.japanese: デザインを{外注|がいちゅう}する。
{人手|ひとで}が{足|た}りないので、{一部|いちぶ}の{業務|ぎょうむ}を{外注|がいちゅう}に{出|だ}した。
examples.english: Since we're short-staffed, we outsourced some of the work.

examples.japanese: {外注|がいちゅう}{先|さき}との{連絡|れんらく}がうまくいかず、{納期|のうき}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった。
examples.english: Communication with the subcontractor didn't go well, and we missed the deadline.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as both a noun and a suru verb. {外注|がいちゅう}する means to outsource or subcontract. {外注|がいちゅう}に{出|だ}す is also a common expression meaning the same thing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外注|がいちゅう}に{出|だ}す: to send out for outsourcing
- {外注|がいちゅう}{先|さき}: subcontractor, outsourcing partner
- {外注|がいちゅう}{費|ひ}: outsourcing costs
- {外注|がいちゅう}{管理|かんり}: outsourcing management
